text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
I'm going to give it all for the race today.
I don't get this sort of chance often,
so this will be a good learning
experience!

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either.
This is a competition after all!

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What was that!?
It's like the entire 
atmosphere felt heavier all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yup. This is looking to be perfect race
weather. 
I'm feeling pretty good myself too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long time since I couldn't 
control my excitement for a race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is a race where not only the horsegirls
on the field will shine,
but also future horsegirls as well. 
That sort of conviction makes my heart
dance.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha.
I guess this is the effect of making the
pamphlet. 
It's okay to be a bit flashy today.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Rudolf! C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this day!
I know this isn't an official race,
but there's no way I can't not get this 
excited for a chance to go against you
two.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I see you've gotten quite into this,
Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Did you forget?
It's my dream to become the "Ace" of 
the horsegirl world!!
To have you two be my opponents 
will naturally get me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I like it.
You two would make for the perfect
opponents. 
… I'm getting excited for this myself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If we really came at each other
seriously, 
I wonder what would happen.
Let's go find out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
wait… That aura over there is insane. 
I'm already starting to sweat…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Woahhhhh!!
You can see the sparks crackling! 
I'm also going to try and make some sparks
fly!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! I'm going to run with all I got!
I don't care 
if this is a special race or who my opponents
are!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No matter when or where,
I will always be the one 
to take the lead!
I'll prove to everyone that the strongest 
one out there is Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really are something else,
not even being a bit nervous. 
But… Well…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on! Even in this situation,
I can't just give up 
the match like that. Come on, me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know that I'm just a small part of the
big 
picture,
but today I'll give it my best shot…!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about! Let's go,
let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The competitors have lined up at the
start! 
A race like this has never been seen
before! 
Who will be the one to take home the glory
of first!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I figured you would be here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh? Don't tell me you're stargazing now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha. I just came to give my thanks.
Thanks to you, 
we were able to make a phenomenal
pamphlet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to thank me. 
I was just doing it to have a bit of fun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once again,
when the race ended a lot of different 
things happened.
The person who took home the glory. 
Those who were unable to grasp it…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dear friends and rivals were able to come
together to compete. 
Their different ideologies clashed with each
other.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Those who stand at the top were able to face
those who sought to make their way there.
The day where they can give those at 
the top a hearty challenge will come
eventually.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And those who stand strong with an unwavering
heart 
that looks towards an unknown future one
step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If anything,
it is the students of Tracen Academy that
are 
"high-spirited." I hope it will remain that
way moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was by creating the pamphlet that I was
able 
to finally realize the true nature of our
school.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And that's why I love this place.

text_block_list.name: Pamphlet-reading Hor...
text_block_list.text:
How pretty! The school seems so fun and 
brilliant! I want to run there one day…!!

text_block_list.name: Pamphlet-reading Hor...
text_block_list.text:
They also seem free to express themselves.
If I worked hard 
and got in,
I wonder if I can do many different things
like that…

text_block_list.name: Pamphlet-reading Hor...
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Wow! Wow!
I want to run in a race just like this!!

text_block_list.name: Hopeful Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: I want to make it there……!!

text_block_list.name: Hopeful Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: I want to run there!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yes. I can feel it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That was the gust of a new wind. 
From someone I have yet to meet. 
That was a wind from the future.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. Well then, let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Of course! Today I won't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yes. Same here.

text_block_list.name: C.B. & Ace
text_block_list.text: Ready, go!!
